reviews_5s: Works well. Smaller than I expected but that's my fault for not reading the size. I used it to crush up some caraway seeds for a recipe. It said to toast them first so I don't know if this helped or hurt. They crushed up fairly well but not as small as I would have liked and I worked at it for awhile. Caraway seeds are a dark brown/black and since I was busy with the other parts of the recipe, after I dumped the seeds in my pot I left the item on the counter. Went to wash it a little later and saw it looked a little stained but with a little elbow work the stains came off. Overall, not bad for price compared to others and I won't be using it very often. I would buy again.Perfect for what I needed it for. My dog will not take his chewable monthly flea/heartworm pill so I have to crush it up and mix it in his food. This mortar and pestle are just what I needed.It came on time, I wish I could say more, but I haven't use.quality is goodExcelenteUse everyday to crush pills for dogA little small but cuteI got the smallest one and the biggest one which is also in the photo I added so you could see them side by side for comparison the biggest to smallest and the smallest is exactly what I needed. The biggest isn’t bad at all but for what I’m going for the smallest ended up working great. It fits perfectly in the palm of your hand. If you are looking for large amounts of medication to be crushed I would choose the larger one but if it’s smaller stuff then choose the little one. It’s light weight but is durable. Portable and easy to use. The larger one was also great to use. I was very happy with it when I used it. I am very happy I ordered it cuz now I have both options if I need them. Plus I know there will be days when I know I need the larger one so it’s a win win. Very happy with this product. The only issue I have is that things get stuck on the side and the only remedy I have found to that is using a plastic straw to get the excess off the sides. I’ve had to do that for years with any of these types of mortars. Plastic straw, always works. Just scrape it off the sides and it works like a gem. But I recommend this 100%. It’s a great buy for the sizes, price, durability and use. So glad I found it. Worth it!very good works perfectlySmall. Well-made. Perfect for grinding herbs for cooking.
reviews_1s:
Since this was my FIRST mortal and pestal I had no clue what to expect. But I recently got a real one that's much bigger, made from granite, and a fraction of the value this one goes for. Such a HUGE difference in how they work. I will most likely junk this, it has no real functional use.

Original: Never used a mortar and pestal before but have been getting more into holistic eating and trying things out. I thought I'd try this little one out at first. It is good for simple uses. Like releasing the yummy flavors from herbs without having to smash on your hand or counter then chop. But it sucks for things like hard fenugreek seeds. To crush them I had to pulse down and that's hard to do with how pointy the pestal is at top that will go into your palm. After awhile my arthritic hand gave up. So I'll definitely need something with a better support in the palm. I also think buying one that isn't as smooth on the inside will help with seeds and things that are harder. I was afraid to buy the ones that looked more coarse, but I think that's what's needed.

For people complaining that the inside of them aren't glazed, that's how they work. Any mortar and pestal you buy will need to be this way to crush things properly. That's the point of it. Do your research before buying. There's ways to prevent bacteria growth and cleaning properly. That isn't the reason these should get lower review ratings or returned.
